neighbours.label: ' other' (and ' among') that extends a list with an open-ended 'and other ...' / 'among other things'
fire: The kit includes screws, washers and other small parts for the shelf.
Our garden has tomatoes, beans and other vegetables that need daily water.
The sailors suffered from hunger, cold and other hardships during the winter.
The museum displays old coins, maps and other artifacts from the colony.
She handles billing, scheduling and other office tasks for the clinic.
The software tracks heart rate, sleep and, among other things, daily steps.
Farmers here grow rice, millet and other grains on the terraced hills.
The report covers costs, staffing and other issues raised by the board.
